GOOD.label: GOOD
GOOD.description: Image has adequate visibility, sharpness, contrast, and anatomical field for automated analysis.

REVIEW.label: REVIEW
REVIEW.description: Borderline quality (0.60–0.85). Clinician review and confirmation advised before proceeding.

POOR.label: POOR
POOR.description: Severe noise, blur, artifact, or acoustic shadowing. Do not proceed to downstream models. Recapture advised.
